title: Evolution Core
description: 🪄 A Minecraft mod where you use magical wands to transform ordinary blocks into rare, powerful ones 🪄
body:
# Evolution Core

**Forge reality. Rewrite progression. Evolve the world itself.**

Evolution Core transforms Minecraft progression into a living evolution system where blocks, materials, biomes, and magic mutate through powerful Evolution Wands and the mysterious Evolution Table. Start with primitive transformations and ascend toward divine-grade evolution capable of reshaping entire environments.

_Discover evolving ores, corrupted mutations, celestial materials, ancient wood types, custom particles, cinematic effects, magical crafting mechanics, and_ **a progression path designed to feel addictive, rewarding, and endlessly expandable.**


```
Every evolution feels powerful. Every upgrade changes the world.
```


## ✦ Features
Custom Evolution Table crafting system
Progression-based magical wand tiers
Block evolution chains & mutations
Stable, Chaotic, Corrupted & Divine evolutions
Stunning particles, sounds & visual effects
Custom ores, woods, soils & celestial materials
Expanding endgame magic progression
Vanilla-friendly but dramatically enhanced gameplay
### ✦ Why Players Love It

Evolution Core blends the satisfaction of tech progression, fantasy magic, and world transformation into one polished experience. It feels like discovering forbidden Minecraft mechanics that should have always existed.
